signals.source_text: Overseer Marduk stood in the consciousness-programming chamber and tried not to calculate the probability of what the Queen was about to do to him.

Queen Eduhauana herself administered the programming—not through crude technological interfaces, but through direct consciousness-touch that bypassed all the defenses Igigi psychology might have mustered.
